name: Kaiju Pothole
blurb: Steer a hungry pothole round town and swallow the lot!

background.css: radial-gradient(circle at 78% 70%, #1E1B2E 0 13%, #4a4560 13% 15.5%, #c9c1b2 15.5% 18%, transparent 18%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 46%, #f4efe2 46% 54%, transparent 54%) center/100% 6px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#5b5670, #5b5670) center/100% 26% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#bfe6f7 0 38%, #7ED957 38%)

source.notes: Title is Bungee in sun yellow #FFC93C with a hard ink #1E1B2E outline and drop, exactly as the game's title and loading screens draw it. The background is the game's town: sky #bfe6f7, grass #7ED957 and the road colour #5b5670 with its dashed centre line, plus a pothole with the default concrete rim (#c9c1b2 / #4a4560), taken from the ground painter in world.js and the asphalt skin in hole.js.
